fact: The World Bank ISR says numerous training sessions for civil servants, a third of them women, were held in 2024 under the digital government component, with 367 civil servants and beneficiaries trained to date against a 2,000 target for Dec 2026.

The digital economy ministry signed a renewable five-year cooperation agreement with HSE University, Moscow, on 9 October 2026 to strengthen civil servants' digital governance skills, per the ministry's statement.

A Ministry of Public Service official says computer training of civil servants has started at the Alliance Francaise, beginning with the ministry before other ministries, under a French-embassy-funded programme.
